evidence.excerpt: Under this formulation, the problem can be decomposed into two key questions: (i) how to identify representative edit points that effectively anchor the edit sub-manifold, and (ii) how to preserve the remaining manifold structure during the sub-manifold displacement process.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Experiments on two base LLMs and four unstructured editing benchmarks demonstrate that ManiEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to +27.81 BERTScore and +8.50 ROUGE-L, while maintaining near-original general capabilities across six representative downstream tasks.
